★ Request
Font size: Large

It was like the most dazzling, vivid flash of light in the entire world.
—Such was our striking first encounter.
...Huh?

U-Um, how about singing then! Let's go to your singing lessons!!
You won that amazing award the other day, remember! I'm sure next time too—

That's right. ...Grandma told me.
She said, "Racing magic was the most incredible of all."

You said it, didn't you?! You just said "magic"!!
Tell me everything about that right now!!

Still thoroughly captivated, I let the word slip out before I could stop myself, sending me into a panic.
Was calling it "magic" way too sudden, no matter how you look at it—

It can't be just mediocre, got it?! It has to be super sweet, delicious,
and look pretty too♪ Now take me! H-U-R-R-Y-!

*sigh*... Jeez. And here I thought
I might finally understand what "racing magic" is.

Fufu... Is that so? Then come along with me.
I'll give you a very special pointed hat of your own.
Haaaaaaaahhh!!

—So, about what you said earlier. You said my running
was like magic, right? What did you mean by that?
Ghhh, be quieeet!

S-Sweepy! There's nothing to hate about it, right? You're great at English!
Your teacher said you even got a perfect score on that hard test the other day—

Pretty flowers... But why?! They weren't here just a second ago!!
And yet... What did you do, how did you do that?! Tell me, Grandma!!

Huh? ...Hey, you!
What are you staring blankly over here for?!
To explain why...

While the result itself was wonderful, relying too heavily on your burst of speed is questionable.
You should be more meticulous in managing your race from the early to mid stages—
I wanna try!! —I wanna use magic too!!

(Even if they praise me for doing good, it's not fun at aaaaall!!
So I hate it! I don't wanna do it anymore! No, no, noooo!)
“Carpe diem”!

Sweep Tosho-san! Come over here quickly!
I'm going to review your performance in that mock race.
Did you say magic?!
NOOOOOOOOO WAAAAAAAYYYYY!!!!

About an hour later. Having finished a parfait loaded with chocolate
and cream, Sweep Tosho was smiling with pure satisfaction.
No, no, nooo! I can't hear youuu!!

Someday, I'm gonna be a great witch just like Grandma.
...That's why I wanna be able to use "racing magic" soon, but...
Huh?! S-Sweep...?!?

Well, duh, of course I am!
Listen up, okay? Magic is, like—

Shut up, shut up, shut up! Stop bossing me around!!
I am NEVER gonna listen to a single thing you say, so there!!

What's that...?
What's that, what's that?! That sounds like so much fun!!

An explosive burst of speed so overwhelming it leaves you breathless. A dazzling, purely brilliant,
heart-thumping run. It was almost like—

"Whoa?!" "Eek?!"
"No way, she's so fast...?!"

Do you want to know? This is... "magic," Sweepy.
I'm a great witch who can use any kind of magic there is!

I'm exhausted from running so much!
I wanna eat pudding, cake, parfaits, I wanna eat it all!
No way!! When I say no, I mean no! I'm not going!!

A certain Umamusume I saw during a mock race.
In the final stretch, coming all the way from the very back, she accelerated, and accelerated, and accelerated—
Magic...?!
Whaaat! That doesn't make any sense at all!!

Since you clearly don't know, I guess I'll enlighten you.
I am Sweepy, the genius magical girl!

Well, smells nice, doesn't it? First, take a nice, deep breath
of that scent and calm yourself, my sweet Sweepy.
Haaaaah!!

Ugh, geez, what is this?! It doesn't feel right at all!
I knew it, this stuff is just totally boring—

*pant*, *pant*—whew!
...Heh-heh, now that felt pretty good—
And so, practically dragged outside against my will—here I am.

Oh, and while we're talking, I want sweets!
Feed me something good. Your treat, of course!

Ahahaha!
You've got a look on your face like everything in the world is boring. Let's see here—
Sweeping past everyone to seize victory...!

No!! No, no, no, no!!
NOOOOOOOO WAYYYYYYYYY!!

(No, no, no, 'cause it's totally boring! Do this,
do that... everyone just bosses me around all the time!)

My sweet Sweepy.
Come, let me teach you the many kinds of magic that add color to life!
Mmm~♪ It's so sweet~♪ And sooo yummyyy~♪
